security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when stvec.MODE=1 (Vectored) and an interrupt arrives, the trap-entry PC is computed as stvec.BASE + (cause << 2). If the CSR module's WARL mask for stvec.BASE truncates lower bits that are required for the vectored offset (e.g., forcing BASE[1:0] = 0 when there are more than 4 interrupt causes), OR if the vectored-address adder incorrectly applies to synchronous exceptions (which must always use stvec.BASE), OR if the MODE field WARL encoding does not accept the value 1, the hardware violates this spec.
security_spec.summary: stvec.MODE Vectored mode (MODE=1) drives trap-entry PC = BASE + 4*cause for interrupts; incorrect WARL masking on BASE/MODE fields or wrong adder triggering on sync exceptions causes traps to vector to wrong handler addresses, enabling privilege-boundary bypass
